name: MapReduce-based Volume Rendering
definition: A multi-GPU parallel volume rendering implementation built using the MapReduce programming model, designed to handle large volumetric datasets by streaming data to GPUs and eliminating the need for custom I/O algorithms.
summary: MapReduce-based Volume Rendering is a multi-GPU parallel technique that streams volumetric data to GPUs, splitting rendering into parallel ray casting and compositing stages to handle large datasets without custom I/O.
